The '''Chamber of Speech''' was a computer system located in a cave accessible from upper [[Kaleth]], a fortress city on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. Established before the [[Force Wars]], the chamber was rediscovered by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] following the Order's relocation to their ancestral [[Planet/Legends|homeworld]].

==History==
Constructed sometime in [[Tython/Legends|Tython's]] ancient history by the [[Je'daii Order]], the Chamber of Speech was a repository of knowledge on the fortress city of [[Kaleth]]'s past and history. An ancient attempt at a [[holocron]], the interface system which included a [[Gatekeeper (Chamber of Speech)|gatekeeper]] was an attempt by the Je'daii to replicate [[Kwa/Legends|Kwa]] technology discovered under Kaleth.<ref name="NOP" /> The gatekeeper presided over the database and helped those interested to access the knowledge stored within.<ref name="TOR" />

Lost for nearly twenty thousand years, the Chamber's machinery became corroded and in poor condition. When the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] resettled the planet, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Do Zonn]] recovered several ancient scrolls that hinted at the Chamber's existence. He sent two of the [[Jedi Temple (Tython)/Legends|Temple's]] Padawans to uncover the secrets of the Chamber, which was heavily defended by ancient [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]].<ref name="TOR" />
